notes: «قرأت على مالك» is the mode of transmission (read to Malik), not a separate link; Malik is the link
Ibn Umar asks «فسألت ماذا قال» and the answer «قالوا نهى أن ينتبذ ...» comes from unnamed people, who give the saying: an unnamed last link
The later «قال ابن عمر فأقبلت نحوه» is the same Companion telling his own story, so only the first «ابن عمر» is taken
